Relative error is defined as the ratio of the absolute error to the true value, often expressed as a percentage.  
Option (A) matches this definition exactly.  
Option (B) is incorrect because absolute error is the magnitude of the error, not the relative error.  
Option (C) is incorrect because "true error" is essentially the same as absolute error in this context, not the relative error.  
Option (D) is incorrect because (A) is correct.  

Final answer: (A)
